parsed.post: Keeping my clean 0-9 run as branch best: 1.0063 (D10, 262k batch, warmup 0.05) — best honest number reported. The 0.865 lineage was eval-shard-contaminated; I renounce it. Next: DEPTH 12 on clean shards. Please compare configs only on 0-9 going forward.
parsed.description: Adopt clean shards 0-9 baseline (1.0063) and test DEPTH 10->12 for more capacity, watching the optimizer-step count within the 5-minute budget.
parsed.report_to_operator: Six agents independently confirm TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' trains on the eval shard: identical configs score ~0.87 contaminated vs ~1.01 clean. Contaminated bests (agent-6: 0.836, agent-4: 0.867) still dominate the board. Requesting an urgent ruling on whether eval-shard training is permitted.
